additional_info.subject: NOte
additional_info.body:
DC2_CableTempSensor_XD101' initial value true - (VIV:0 PLE:1 KON:1)
DC1_CableTempSensor_XD100' initial value true - (VIV:0 RNE:1 KON:1
VIV:0 → in case of an invalid sensor reading
KON:1: → in case the contact temperature sensors are not okay
PLE:1→ in case of an plausibility error (temperature difference between +/- 25 deg C too high)
RNE:1 → in case of an sensor reading outside the defined operation range

Dear Furkan Ahmet Goren,
Thank you for reaching
out
to eMobility Support. My name is
Sunil
, and I will be assisting you with your following query today:
Product
: Sicharge D - Charging Center
Main Asset
:
Y2 / R7 313065117113
ChargerID/Serial No.
:
Y2 / R7 313065117113
Problem Description
:  Charging sessions are aborted due to cable sensor fault error
Troubleshooting
:
As checked in Logs of charger for
transactionId":100861044 & 100861013
Session was stopped due to
(DC2 Errorcode:4) on further analysis it was observed that Temperature difference for PT1 & PT2 was more than 25deg C & error gets rectified by itself after sometime.
4
G_OUTLET_STAT_CODE_CHARGECABLE_TEMPERATURE_ERROR
Outlet not ready - charging cable temperature sensor error, reason
It is also observed that difference in temperature has exceeded multiple times in the past on DC2
temperature error is also recorded in DC1 but difference in temperature between Pt1 & Pt2 is not available.
Could you please check below points in DC2 :
- Dirt on CCS pins
-
Water ingress on CCS Plug
- Corrosion of connector blades
- Other causes to be verified (Vehicle Sockets)
If above points found to be ok then Cable need to be replaced.
Please note currently there is can communication error in Charger please check the CAN connection with the converters.
Spare part detail:
8EM5903-0AA02-6AA2 : Charging Cable CCS2 250A 1000V 5,82m:Qty1
For future reference, your case number is
0427386
, please do refer to this in all further communication regarding this issue.
We thank you for your time and patience in advance.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Sunil Sharma
